card.summary: A microcontroller by Footprint QFN-56-1EP 7x7mm P0.4mm EP3.2x3.2mm.
32Mb Serial Flash Memory, Standard/Dual/Quad SPI, DFN-8 Footprint W25Q16JVUXIQ.
Push button switch, generic, two pins Footprint ALPSALPINE SKRPACE010.
Positive 60-250mA Low Dropout Regulator, Fixed Output, SOT-23 Footprint SOT-23-3.
USB Type C, right-angle, SMT Footprint USB C Receptacle G-Switch GT-USB-7010ASV.
Generic connector, single row, 01x20, script generated (library-utils/schlib/autogen/connector/) Footprint PinHeader 1x20 P2.54mm Vertical.
Generic connector, single row, 01x03, script generated (library-utils/schlib/autogen/connector/) Footprint PinHeader 1x03 P2.54mm Vertical.
Generic connectable mounting pin connector, single row, 01x03, script generated (library-utils/schlib/autogen/connector/) Footprint SH BM03B-SRSS-TB 1x03-1MP P1.00mm Vertical.
Four pin crystal, GND on pins 2 and 4 Footprint Crystal SMD 3225-4Pin 3.2x2.5mm.
